description: Medicare plan summary panel. Shows plan type header, bold plan name, Part A/B coverage start dates, optional cost summary (premium/deductible/coinsurance/out-of-pocket max), and a details link. Prefer over Card+Text+Link composition for Medicare plan display.

example.planName:
Hospital Insurance (Part A)
Medical Insurance (Part B)

propDescriptions.planType: Plan category label, e.g. 'Original Medicare' or 'Medigap Alternative'
propDescriptions.planName: Full plan name; newline characters render as line breaks
propDescriptions.partACoverageDate: Part A coverage start date or coverage description, e.g. '8/12/2019' or 'Covers Part A coinsurance'
propDescriptions.partBCoverageDate: Part B coverage start date or coverage description, e.g. '8/12/2019' or 'Covers Part B coinsurance'
propDescriptions.monthlyPremium: Monthly premium string, e.g. '$174.70/month'. Omit if unknown.
propDescriptions.annualDeductible: Annual deductible string, e.g. '$257/year'. Omit if unknown.
propDescriptions.coinsuranceAfterDeductible: Coinsurance rate after deductible, e.g. '20%' or '$0 (fully covered)'
propDescriptions.detailsHref: URL for the coverage details link

description: VA appointment summary card. Shows provider, facility, date/time, type badge, and status. Prefer over Card+Badge+Text composition for VA appointment display.

VA claim status timeline. Shows 5-step progress (Received → Review → Evidence → Rating → Decision) with current step highlighted. Prefer over ProcessList+Badge composition for VA claim status display.
GI Bill / benefit entitlement summary panel. Shows program, total/used/remaining entitlement, expiration, and current enrollment. Prefer over Card+Text composition for GI Bill or benefit display.
VA facility locator card. Shows facility name, type badge, address, phone, distance, and hours. Prefer over Card+Text+Badge composition for VA facility display.

example.address: 3710 SW US Veterans Hospital Rd, Portland, OR 97239

propDescriptions.waitTime: Average wait time, e.g. '12 days average'
